server-contracts.a2a.dataDepth: a data part cannot be nested more than {max} levels deep
server-contracts.a2a.dataSize: a data part as JSON cannot exceed {max} characters
server-contracts.a2a.fileSize: a single file cannot exceed {max} bytes
server-contracts.a2a.metadataDepth: metadata cannot be nested more than {max} levels deep
server-contracts.a2a.metadataSize: metadata as JSON cannot exceed {max} characters
server-contracts.a2a.noUrl: url parts are not accepted: {product} does not fetch things from the network for the caller; put the file's bytes in raw
server-contracts.a2a.onePart: each part must have exactly one of text, raw, url, data
server-contracts.a2a.weakReadOnly: Read-only guarantee: weak. When answering an "ask", this AI uses the harness's plan mode, which cannot guarantee that no file is changed.
server-contracts.command.shape: must be an absolute path or a command name (no path separator; a relative path would be resolved in the session's working directory)
server-contracts.env.legacyRenamed: {old} is deprecated, use {name} (the environment variable {old} was renamed to {name}; please use the new name)
server-contracts.file.otherAccount: it does not belong to the account running {product}
server-contracts.file.othersCanWrite: other accounts can change it (mode 0{mode}; run chmod go-w and try again)
server-contracts.harnessFile.broken: {where}: {why}; none of its harnesses were loaded
server-contracts.harnessFile.notArray: {where}: the content must be a JSON array; none of its harnesses were loaded
server-contracts.harnessFile.notObject: each entry must be an object
server-contracts.harnessFile.untrusted: {where}: {why}; not used, none of its harnesses were loaded
server-contracts.json.atLineColumn: not valid JSON near line {line}, column {column}
server-contracts.message.empty: Enter a message, an attachment or a terminal result
